justification: Both surfaces bear schematic, shallow-relief carved motifs including small human-like figures, circles/discs and crescent or curved forms, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A is a scattered open-field composition dominated by long crewed boats with rows of stroke-like crew marks and cup marks, while B is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure (head, torso, arms) whose body carries paired arcs, discs and a ring motif in a fixed symmetrical layout on the body; there is no correspondence in subject, relationships or arrangement.
